summary: MineralRite Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a non-reliance on previously issued financial statements under Item 4.02. The company concluded accounting for its acquisition of Peeples Inc. should be revised from business combination to asset acquisition under ASC 805-50, affecting its 2025 10-K and Q1 2026 10-Q. Revisions involve non-cash acquisition accounting, valuation, and presentation; no fraud or operational issues. The company will file amended reports. This is a routine accounting restatement disclosure, not a special situation.
